verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full REST/JSON API covering registration, renewal, transfer, contact/DNS/nameserver management, with dryRun pre-flight checks and Idempotency-Key support explicitly aimed at scripted deploys, plus a sandbox key for full end-to-end testing without real charges. This directly supports the story of scripting registration end-to-end via API calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a full purchase-to-nameserver flow working in practice (community evidence is unrelated to API usage), and no accessible OpenAPI/machine-readable spec was found (404s on openapi.json/swagger.json).
